links.outcome: Effect of annotation label noise on segmentation performance estimates against clean test data
links.effect: Models overfit label noise, especially boundary-dependent noise (dilation, shrinkage); apparent scores under noisy conditions overestimated true performance on clean test data, most for boundary-altering noise.
links.quote: Discrepancies were identified between apparent performance scores obtained under real-world conditions and true performance scores derived using clean test data.

unlisted_practices: Standardized quantification and mitigation of label noise in pathology annotation datasets

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks the impact of simulated annotation label noise on model evaluation and performance overestimation in digital pathology segmentation.
